name: remedial_intervention_cohort
description: Offer a school-subsidized pilot targeting 15-20 struggling students (below grade level) with 1:1 tutoring for 12 weeks, measuring pre/post assessment gains and teacher-reported classroom improvement.

name: competition_prep_enrichment
description: Partner with school's gifted program or math club to provide advanced 1:1 coaching for students preparing for Math Olympiad, AMC, or other competitions — position as extending what teachers can't resource.

name: homework_help_after_school
description: Integrate Cuemath as a structured after-school homework help program where students get 1:1 support on assignments, reducing incomplete homework and parent frustration — pilot with parent-funded model.

name: teacher_referral_pathway
description: Create a referral system where teachers identify students needing extra support; school shares Cuemath info with parents, and teachers get progress reports via parent app to close the loop — builds teacher buy-in.

name: summer_bridge_program
description: Offer Cuemath as a summer learning option to prevent 'summer slide' in math, especially for students moving to middle school or who struggled during the year — less disruptive than school-year launch.

name: parent_info_session_pilot
description: Run a free parent webinar (hosted by school) explaining MathFit philosophy and offering discounted trial for school families — lets school offer value without budget commitment, builds demand organically.

name: data_sharing_partnership
description: Propose a research partnership where Cuemath shares anonymized progress data with school's math department to inform curriculum adjustments — positions Cuemath as a diagnostic tool, not just a service.
